map.根据晨尿白蛋白排泄评估早期肾损伤，支持多种检测方式: Evaluate early kidney injury from morning urine albumin excretion, supporting multiple testing methods
map.「根据晨尿白蛋白排泄评估早期肾损伤，支持多种检测方式」按输入参数进行专业计算并输: This tool performs professional calculations and outputs results based on the input parameters.
map.诊断微量白蛋白尿需3-6个月内3次检测中至少2次阳性，排除尿路感染、剧烈运动、心: Diagnosing microalbuminuria requires at least 2 positive results out of 3 tests within 3-6 months, excluding interference from urinary tract infection, strenuous exercise, or heart failure.
map.提示：微量白蛋白尿是糖尿病肾病最早期的标志，也提示心血管事件风险增加。ACEI/: Note: Microalbuminuria is the earliest marker of diabetic kidney disease and also signals increased cardiovascular risk. ACEI/ARB agents can reduce proteinuria and delay renal function decline. For learning reference only. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.30–300 为微量白蛋白尿→糖尿病肾病 III 期，启动 ACEI/ARB、控: 30-300 indicates microalbuminuria → stage III diabetic kidney disease; initiate ACEI/ARB and control glycemia and blood pressure.
map.UACR<30 正常，糖尿病/高血压者每年复查。: UACR <30 is normal; diabetics/hypertensives should recheck annually.
map.早于大量蛋白尿出现，是早期肾损伤的敏感标志。: Appears before macroproteinuria; a sensitive marker of early kidney injury.
map.运动/感染/血尿可假阳性，需晨尿或重复确认。: Exercise/infection/hematuria can cause false positives; confirm with morning urine or repeat testing.
map.关于「微量白蛋白(晨尿)意义评估器」: About the Morning Urine Microalbumin Significance Evaluator
map.微量白蛋白尿晨尿意义评估器，根据晨尿白蛋白浓度及UACR评估早期肾损伤，用于糖尿: The Morning Urine Microalbumin evaluator assesses early kidney injury from morning urine albumin concentration and UACR, used for early screening of diabetic and hypertensive kidney disease. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.白蛋白尿分级（KDIGO 2012 CKD 指南 A1/A2/A3）：尿白蛋白/: Albuminuria grading (KDIGO 2012 CKD A1/A2/A3): urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) A1 <30, A2 30–300, A3 >300 mg/g; concentration A1 <20, A2 20–200, A3 >200 mg/L; 24h quantification A1 <30, A2 30–300, A3 >300 mg/d. A single result cannot confirm; repeat 2–3 times within 3–6 months and exclude infection/exercise/fever. Thresholds from different methods must not be mixed; results are hints requiring clinical review.
map.请输入有效的白蛋白尿数值（0–10000，按所选单位）；留空不判读，也不按 0: Enter a valid albuminuria value (0–10000 in the selected unit); blank is not interpreted and is never counted as 0/normal.
